captions.detailed: This 3D model is a flat, extruded musical eighth note pendant designed for jewelry. It features an oval-shaped note head at the bottom, a straight stem extending upwards, and a curved flag waving off to the right. At the top of the stem, a circular mounting ring is integrated for attaching a chain or clasp, maintaining the same uniform extrusion thickness as the musical symbol.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric OpenSCAD script for a musical notation jewelry pendant. It should support selecting different musical symbols (like an eighth note) and include an attached mounting ring at the top with adjustable parameters for its position, inner radius, wall thickness, and extrusion height.
captions.factory: The design uses a 2D-to-3D workflow where the entire geometry is extruded using linear_extrude with a height of z_height. The 2D profile is created by a difference operation: a union of the selected musical item and an outer circle representing the ring, minus an inner circle that forms the ring's hole. The eighth note is built using basic 2D primitives: hull of circles to form the angled oval note head, a thin square for the stem, and a custom polygon for the flag.
